description: The line plot illustrates the time cost in seconds for two different computational scenarios—“w/o Pre-computation” (blue line) and “w Pre-computation” (orange line)—as a function of the paper number, with the x-axis representing the paper number on a logarithmic scale ranging from 1 to 256 and the y-axis showing the time cost in seconds from 0 to 35. The blue line, representing the scenario without pre-computation, starts at approximately 2 seconds for paper number 1 and increases steadily, reaching about 34 seconds for paper number 256, indicating a significant rise in time cost as the paper number grows. In contrast, the orange line, representing the scenario with pre-computation, remains nearly flat and close to 2 seconds across all paper numbers, showing minimal variation and a much lower time cost compared to the blue line. This suggests that pre-computation significantly reduces the time cost, especially as the paper number increases.
